related_questions.question: How to look up property taxes paid?
related_questions.title: Here are some ways to figure it out:
list: Check box 10 (Other) on Form 1098 from your mortgage company.
Review your bank or credit card records if you paid the property/real estate tax yourself.
Go to your city or county tax assessor's website and look for a link to Property search or Property Tax records.

related_questions.question: What happens if you don't pay property taxes in New Mexico?
related_questions.snippet: If your New Mexico property taxes are delinquent for more than two years, your home will be added to a "tax delinquency list." (N.M. Stat. § 7-38-61 (2024).) Three years after the first delinquent date shown on the list, the Taxation and Revenue Department will schedule a sale to sell your home to pay off the tax debt.
